rows.corpus_definition: To laugh at someone in a mean or unkind way.
rows.example_en: He did not want his peers to ridicule him.
Rumors were rife after the CEO suddenly resigned.

rows.corpus_definition: A loud and violent protest by a group of people.
rows.example_en: The city was quiet after the scary riot ended.

rows.corpus_definition: A place where birds sit or sleep at night.

rows.corpus_definition: To give up something valuable for a good reason.
rows.example_en: She had to sacrifice sleep to study.

rows.corpus_definition: For the purpose of helping someone or something.
rows.example_en: I did it for the sake of peace.

rows.corpus_definition: Having a healthy and normal mind.
rows.example_en: It is hard to remain sane in this noise.

rows.corpus_definition: To move quickly using your hands and feet.
rows.example_en: They had to scramble up the rocky hill.

rows.corpus_definition: To write something quickly in a messy way.

rows.corpus_definition: A person whose job is to copy documents by hand.
rows.example_en: The ancient scribe wrote the story on parchment.
